steps.content: With Zoya handling the main battleground, you have time to retreat to the side and take a look at the trophies.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Here, Thou Voodoos' cane.
The top of the cane is embellished with a bizarre crystal, bright red and gleaming. Although it's slightly different from the liquid Iron has shown you, you will never mistake this ominous feeling...
It's a <color=#fb9259>Mania Crystal</color>.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: It's a Syndican specialty, a Mania weapon embedded with crystals.
He's already used to your spontaneous questions.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: It offers different abilities through the activation of the Mania Crystal. The gangs use it against the Legion too. They desire power as strong as Sinners'.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: They've got what they want. When a user attacks with the Mania weapon, their own mental activity will be amplified as well.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: To put it simply, the more bloodthirsty the user becomes, the stronger the Mania weapon's effect.

options: And does the Legion want it too?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Only the weak imitate. We don't need that.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: But you should still be careful. The Mania weapon won't cause severe contamination in the user directly, but that's only because the contamination is all transferred to the victim.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You better watch out for stray bullets around you.
The gangsters who've been subdued by Zoya have obviously gone insane.

steps.speaker: Red Falcon mob
steps.content: Use up your bullets before you go! Destroy as many of the Legionnaires as you can, turn them all into monsters!
Fretfully, they're blasting out all the bullets at the Legion, completely heedless of their own allies still on the battleground.

steps.speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
steps.content: No, no, don't do that —We're still here, don't shoot, wait till we've left before you...

steps.speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He's turned into a Corruptor! Those Red Falcon scum are definitely doing it on purpose. They're betraying their allies to buy time!
As the bullets are about to hit the Legionnaires, several Gonzales guys are thrown out one after another to take this wave of contamination attack. They're howling and their bodies begin to distort.

steps.speaker: Legionnaire
steps.content: Commander!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You guys, kill these monsters. I'm going after those spineless traitors!
Her voice is low. Before anyone can respond, she runs straight in the direction the Red Falcon has fled.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Even if she said that, handling this number of monsters while watching over several noobs is not that easy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cut the crap! If it hadn't been for the bomb, I would have already knocked off your head!

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Oh? Then how about the Legion takes care of the front, and you take care of those guys at the back?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Just call for someone if you can't handle it anymore, the Legion will send help, Chief.
